title: Handshake: Partner-Specific Protein-Protein Binding Site Prediction at Scale Using ProstT5 and Cross-Chain Attention
one_liner_zh: 该文用ProstT5蛋白语言模型和跨链注意力做蛋白质-蛋白质结合位点预测，虽非TF-DNA体系，但其序列级互作界面建模与AI方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点预测，具有借鉴价值。
abstract: Partner-specific protein-protein binding site prediction, identifying which residues of a protein form the interface when bound to a specific partner, remains a challenging task with significant implications for drug discovery and understanding of protein structure and function. Existing computational methods are limited by small training datasets, inconsistent redundancy filtering, and reliance on three-dimensional structural information at test time. Here we present a sequence-only, partner-specific protein-protein interface predictor called HandShake. It combines ProstT5, a protein language model pre-trained on structural data, with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a cross-chain attention mechanism and a contact supervision head. Our method can detect both binding interfaces and pairwise contact matrices. We trained our model on very large datasets of non-redundant protein-protein pairs derived from the PPInterface dataset, the most comprehensive structural protein-protein database to date, and evaluated it on systematically filtered benchmarks at four redundancy thresholds (30%–90% sequence identity). We demonstrate that sequence redundancy inflates reported AUROC by up to 0.079 and MCC by up to 0.145 on identical models, representing a substantial methodological confound in the field. Even at 30% redundancy threshold, our results (AUROC=0.811, MCC=0.367, F1=0.45) exceed the best published sequence-only result on this convention. Our method also achieves comparable performance to existing partner-specific methods that use explicit structural information. The comprehensive training and evaluation dataset, in addition to the systematic redundancy inflation, can help gain insight into protein-protein interactions and the abilities and limitations of current detection methods. Data availability The code and data can be found at http://github.com/nurith/Handshake . Author summary Understanding which residues of a protein make contact with a specific protein partner is fundamental for designing drugs and understanding cellular processes, but predicting these interfaces remains challenging. We developed a deep learning method that takes only the amino acid sequences of two proteins and predicts, for each residue, whether it lies on their binding interface. The method combines ProstT5, a protein language model trained to translate between sequence and structure, with a cross-chain attention mechanism that lets each protein’s residues attend to its partner. We train and evaluate on up to 32,503 non-redundant protein pairs across four sequence redundancy thresholds. To the best of our knowledge, this is by far the largest dataset trained and tested for this specific task. Our key methodological finding: sequence redundancy in evaluation benchmarks inflates reported metrics by up to 0.079 AUROC and 0.145 MCC on identical models when measured internally on PPInterface. Inference experiments on four independent benchmarks show that this internal inflation does not transfer cleanly to externally-curated datasets, where switching from 30%-trained to 90%-trained models changes performance only modestly. At 30% filtering, our method achieves AUROC values from 0.784 to 0.828 across five datasets, confirming genuine generalization. Through systematic negative controls and comparisons with the ESM-2 family of language models at matched parameter counts, we show that explicit structural pre-training, not just model scale, is what enables sequence-only binding site prediction to work.
abstract_zh: 伴侣特异性蛋白-蛋白结合位点预测，即识别蛋白质在与特定伴侣结合时形成界面的残基，仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，对药物发现以及理解蛋白质结构和功能具有重要意义。现有计算方法受限于小型训练数据集、不一致的冗余过滤，以及在测试时依赖三维结构信息。在此，我们提出一种仅基于序列的伴侣特异性蛋白-蛋白界面预测器，名为HandShake。它结合了ProstT5（一种在结构数据上预训练的蛋白质语言模型）与低秩适应（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）、跨链注意力机制和接触监督头。我们的方法能够检测结合界面和成对接触矩阵。我们在从PPInterface数据集（迄今为止最全面的结构蛋白-蛋白数据库）衍生的超大非冗余蛋白-蛋白对数据集上训练了模型，并在四个冗余阈值（30%–90%序列同一性）下系统过滤的基准上进行了评估。我们证明，在相同模型上，序列冗余会使报告的AUROC最多虚高0.079，MCC最多虚高0.145，这代表了该领域一个重大的方法学混淆因素。即使在30%冗余阈值下，我们的结果（AUROC=0.811，MCC=0.367，F1=0.45）也超过了该约定下已发表的最佳仅序列结果。我们的方法在性能上也与使用显式结构信息的现有伴侣特异性方法相当。全面的训练和评估数据集，加上系统性的冗余膨胀分析，有助于深入了解蛋白-蛋白相互作用以及当前检测方法的能力和局限性。数据可用性：代码和数据可在http://github.com/nurith/Handshake获取。作者总结：理解蛋白质的哪些残基与特定蛋白伴侣接触，对于设计药物和理解细胞过程至关重要，但预测这些界面仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了一种深度学习方法，仅利用两种蛋白质的氨基酸序列，预测每个残基是否位于其结合界面上。该方法结合了ProstT5（一种训练用于序列与结构之间转换的蛋白质语言模型）与跨链注意力机制，使每个蛋白质的残基能够关注其伴侣。我们在四个序列冗余阈值下，对多达32,503个非冗余蛋白-蛋白对进行了训练和评估。据我们所知，这是该特定任务中迄今训练和测试的最大数据集。我们的关键方法学发现：在评估基准中的序列冗余，在PPInterface上内部测量时，会使相同模型的报告指标最多虚高0.079 AUROC和0.145 MCC。在四个独立基准上的推理实验表明，这种内部膨胀并不能干净地转移到外部策划的数据集，在这些数据集中，从30%训练模型切换到90%训练模型仅会适度改变性能。在30%过滤下，我们的方法在五个数据集上实现了0.784至0.828的AUROC值，确认了真正的泛化能力。通过系统性的阴性对照和与ESM-2系列语言模型在匹配参数数量下的比较，我们表明，显式结构预训练（而不仅仅是模型规模）是使仅序列结合位点预测得以实现的关键。
